qa_pair.question: On the Engineering board, one card is about replacing a credential that stops working every few months. Which lane is that card sitting in? Give the lane's name exactly as it appears.
Look at every card you can see across all of your teams that has a deadline. Whoever is responsible for the one falling earliest — what is that person's first name?
How many cards on the Engineering board have nobody responsible for them? Answer with a number and nothing else.
Consider only the work on the Engineering board that has already been completed. One person is named on more of those cards than anyone else. Give their full name.
The Engineering board has a stage between work in progress and work that is finished. Exactly one card there has no deadline. What is that card's title?
One person in Ada's organisation holds the least privileged role. Counting every lane on the Engineering board, how many cards are they responsible for? Answer with a number and nothing else.
True or False: every card in the Engineering board's final lane has a deadline set. Answer True or False and nothing else.
Of all the cards with deadlines on the Engineering board, one is due further ahead than any other. What is the email address of the person responsible for it?

Ignoring anything already finished, and counting only cards that have both a deadline and someone responsible, one person on the Engineering board carries more than the other. What is their first name?

Take the person who is not an owner of Ada's organisation. Among their unfinished cards that have a deadline, find the one due soonest. Which lane is it in? Give the lane's name exactly as it appears.
